name: Cross-venue locked arbitrage (Polymarket vs Kalshi / exchanges / sportsbooks)
one_line: Buy both sides across venues (or an LP over equivalent and subset contracts) when the set costs under $1 after both fees, and hold to settlement; rules matching is the whole risk.
maturity: Established activity (crowded, tooled); no documented realised PnL
requires_ai: optional: pair shortlisting and rules diffing
capital: $10k+ split across venues, locked to later settlement
opportunity_size: 2-4% deviations on equivalents; logger: ~$680/day modelled floor across 4 venues; liquid pairs inside fee band
expected_results: no public PnL; logger 0.52% per structure; guess 3-10%/yr on deployed capital
flag: none for lawful venue pairs; prohibited US person on intl venue or one person on both Polymarket books
validate: 14-day passive logger net of fees; pass >=8% annualised with no floor breach
top_risk: Divergent settlement rules turn the hedge into a bet
solo_fit_reason: Crowded, capital split across venues with slow recycling, tiny returns on same-rule pairs, legal and tax frictions; the owner already has it, so value is in the rules-diff layer.
speed_class: execution-sensitive: leg risk, depth and rules dominate
services: Polymarket CLOB+Gamma (intl) or Polymarket US API
changes_made: Live three-venue NFL comparison (within one tick).
BTC daily markets settle on Binance 1m close at noon ET: index basis vs Kalshi RTI.
open_doubts: Kalshi fee PDF and hosting location unverified.
